source_name: English Wikipedia REST API — page summary for airport public profiles

license.name: CC BY-SA 4.0
license.attribution: Text from English Wikipedia is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. The airport_public_profiles table stores a WikipediaAttribution (title, page id, revision id, content url) per row.

what_it_provides: Short structured summary (title, pageid, revision, description, extract, thumbnail url, content_urls, optional wikibase_item) for an English Wikipedia article, used to build an airport's public profile (summary, short description, thumbnail). The QID returned in 'wikibase_item' is then used to drive a Wikidata fetch for structured facts.
fields_collected: wikibase_item (qid for the linked Wikidata entity)

refresh_policy.schedule_note: Profiles are fetched on demand when a user opens the airport public-profile panel. Cached for 30 days (TTL set by airport_public_profile_normalizer). Subsequent fetches are gated by the airport_public_profile_fetch_runs claim/lock flow.

freshness_policy.notes: 30-day TTL is enforced both in the payload (expires_at) and in the worker claim/reuse path. Versions are recorded in airport_public_profile_versions regardless of whether the content hash changed.

raw_storage.bucket: n/a (no raw blob persisted; response is parsed inline and stored as normalized fields in airport_public_profiles / airport_public_profile_versions)
raw_storage.path_pattern: not applicable — see airport_public_profiles + airport_public_profile_versions tables instead

collector.name: wikimedia_wikidata_fetcher.fetch_wikipedia_summary (and fetch_airport_public_data)
collector.user_agent: god-eyes/1.0 (https://github.com/anomalyco/god-eyes; god-eyes@example.com) WikipediaEnrichmentFetcher/1.0 — required by Wikimedia policy; do NOT anonymize

frontend_usage.barrel: apps/web/src/layers/layer_01_aviation/index.ts re-exports useAirportPublicProfile and the profile types
frontend_usage.notes: Frontend only knows the API response shape (consumed via the public-profile endpoint), not the upstream provider. The bundled source_id 'airport_public_enrichment' is the pipeline-level identifier — Wikipedia and Wikidata are registered separately in the source catalog.

known_limitations: English Wikipedia only (no other language Wikipedias); canonical decision enforced in the fetcher docstring and the airport_intelligence_normalizer.
User-Agent is mandatory per Wikimedia policy; the documented UA in airport_public_profile.py is a placeholder email that may be replaced by a real ops contact before production.
Wikimedia uses a 'tid' header for client-side caching; the fetcher currently does not propagate If-None-Match / If-Modified-Since.
The full Wikipedia page is never stored; only the summary payload fields and attribution metadata.
pipeline_source_id_note: The fetcher and normalizer write rows with the bundled pipeline source_id 'airport_public_enrichment' (defined in packages/schemas/layers/layer_01_aviation/airport_public_profile.py as SOURCE_ID). The airport_source_links table also records source_type='wikipedia' for cross-references; this catalog entry is keyed on the upstream provider.
notes: This catalog source_id ('wikipedia_rest_airport_profiles') identifies the upstream provider only; it is not the value persisted in the DB. The pipeline-level source_id is 'airport_public_enrichment' (see pipeline_source_id_note).
The bundled pipeline also pulls the 'wikibase_item' (QID) from this endpoint to drive the Wikidata fetch. That QID is recorded on the profile (wikidata_qid) and the linked airport_source_links row.
